BiblicalUsage: Perverseness is the crookedness Daniel tells Nebuchadnezzar to break off. In Daniel 4:27 Daniel says, break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor, if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Daniel's counsel is the only way out of perverseness: break it off, do right, and show mercy, and the king's peace may last a little longer.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
